purpose: Teach: 釜/両替/酸性/バニラ/ともだち/オールスター/ジャイアンツ/ペラペラ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、本気で、絶対、お釜、絶対、ご飯、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku, you definitely learned how to cook rice in a proper pot in home-ec, right?
lines.style: Bright, teasing confidence. Quick opening. Playful accusation — she's about to make a point. Warm rhythm, like she's calling out a friend she knows well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、両替、絶対、必要だぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. And we definitely learned about currency exchange on that school trip, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, matching her energy but grounded. Matter-of-fact delivery on the practical details. A small smile underneath — he sees where she's going with this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 理科で、本気で、絶対、酸性、絶対、と、絶対、アルカリ性、絶対、習ったよね、リク、本気for
lines.en: You learned about acids and bases in science, right, Riku?
lines.style: Softer now. Building something. Thoughtful pause before the question. Setting up a pattern — testing whether he's following her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: コンビニの、本気で、絶対、バニラ、絶対、シェイク、絶対、美味かったぜ、桜
lines.en: And that vanilla shake from the convenience store was really good, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated but still tracking her logic. Slight lift on the memory — he's playing along, waiting for the connection. Gentle humor in his voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、ともだち、絶対、皆、絶対、優しいよね、リク
lines.en: Your friends are all really kind, you know that, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. The teasing drops for a moment. She means this. Quiet affirmation — not overdone, just true.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気for、絶対、オールスター、絶対、戦、絶対、テレビで、絶対、見てるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: And your grandfather watches the All-Star game on TV, doesn't he, Sakura?
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly softer. He's feeling something here — the weight of the pattern she's building. Steady delivery, like he's remembering as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、本気で、絶対、ジャイアンツ、絶対、ファン、絶対、なんでしょ?リク
lines.en: Your dad's a Giants fan, isn't he, Riku?
lines.style: Direct but gentle. She's narrowing the focus now. Curious without pushing. The question carries a small weight — she's circling toward something that matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、英語、絶対、ペラペラ、絶対、になってきたよな、桜
lines.en: You've really gotten fluent in English, haven't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft admiration. Not flashy praise — just honest notice. Warm and close. He's seeing her clearly, and she knows it.
